brief:
A Palestinian student accepted to a British university said the ongoing conflict in Gaza has prevented him from beginning his studies, according to Dawn. The student, who received confirmation of his admission, expressed uncertainty about his prospects despite what would typically represent a pivotal opportunity for academic advancement. He noted that in Gaza, unlike elsewhere, such acceptance letters have failed to translate into the start of new educational chapters.

The conflict has disrupted normal life trajectories for Gaza's students, with admission to foreign universities no longer guaranteeing the ability to travel or resume academic pursuits. Palestinians seeking to study abroad face obstacles to leaving the territory and continuing their education.
dek: When I received the email confirming that I had been given an opportunity to continue my university studies in the United Kingdom, I was unsure how to feel. Typically, such correspondence would mark the beginning of a new chapter in a student’s life: a new university, new lecture halls, new classmates and a new city. In Gaza, however, the opposite is true.
title: Gaza war blocks Palestinians from pursuing studies abroad
